We have a tool function math_hcf. We can call it twice for each pair. But the user wants to use the result of first to find second? Actually they want to use the result of (45,60) to find GCD of (90,120). But GCD of (90,120) is independent. But maybe they want to illustrate that if you multiply both numbers by same factor, GCD scales accordingly. So we can compute GCD(45,60)=15. Then GCD(90,120)=30 which is 2*15. Similarly GCD(36,48)=12. Then GCD(72,96)=24 which is 2*12.
